chapter_title_en: The Twenty-Seven Worlds of Daofather Fuju
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 587 – Ji Ning Visits the Twenty-Seven Worlds of Daofather Fuju
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning steps into his role as Manor Lord and begins his journey through the Three Realms, heading to the legendary worlds of the fallen number one Sword Immortal to study his peerless sword traces.
og_title: The Twenty-Seven Worlds of a Fallen Sword God
og_description: Ji Ning travels to the East Luan World, one of the twenty-seven realms left by the legendary Daofather Fuju, to study his legendary sword traces and seek a breakthrough.
twitter_description: Ji Ning sends away his Empyrean God retinue to quietly study the legendary sword traces of Daofather Fuju, the fallen #1 Sword Immortal of the Three Realms.

lore_anchors.definition: The fallen number one Sword Immortal of the Three Realms, known for his fifth-level Sword Force and the peerless Five Treasures Sword Art. He mysteriously died in the Chaos.
The legendary, peerless sword technique created by Daofather Fuju that made him the undisputed number one Sword Immortal of the Three Realms.

A power that naturally manifests at a Sword Immortal's blade when they master the Grand Dao of the Sword; divided into five levels, with the fifth level placing a cultivator among the pinnacle of True Gods and Daofathers.
Imprints of sword intent left on the physical environment by a powerful cultivator, which later generations can study to gain insight.
The eldest-looking of the seven Empyrean Gods under the Starseizing Manor, a newly promoted Fiendgod who received the Pure Yang treasure ‘All-Devouring Bloodshadow Formation’.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Ji Ning send away most of his Empyrean God bodyguards?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Ji Ning is on a personal journey of cultivation and discovery; a large entourage would be conspicuous and hinder his goal of tempering himself in the mortal world.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What are the Twenty-Seven Worlds of Fuju?
cultural_notes_faq.a: They are twenty-seven minor worlds where Daofather Fuju left sword traces while training; they are now open to the public for any cultivator to study.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is it dangerous to study the sword traces?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Yes. Forcing comprehension beyond one's limit can lead to a devilish trance (Qi Deviation), causing injury or death, as seen with the small demon.
